entries.name: revit_activate_view
entries.title: activate view
entries.summary: Activate a supported Revit view in the already bound model; no automatic model rebind.
entries.when_to_use: Navigate to an existing view ID in the bound Revit model.

entries.name: revit_count_elements
entries.title: count elements
entries.summary: Count placed elements via native aggregate; no 5,000-list cap.
entries.when_to_use: Get exact placed-instance count without enumerating all instances.

entries.name: revit_create_detail_line
entries.title: create detail line
entries.summary: Create a detail line annotation in a view. Detail lines are view-specific and do not affect the model geometry. All coordinates are in Revit internal units (feet). Args: view_id: The view ID to place the detail line in. start_x: Start point X coordin
entries.when_to_use: Write capability is not yet enabled; discover only and do not execute.

entries.name: revit_create_dimension
entries.title: create dimension
entries.summary: Create a dimension annotation between elements. Args: view_id: The view ID to place the dimension in. references: List of element references to dimension. Each reference should be a dict with "element_id" key. At least 2 references required. dimensio
entries.when_to_use: Write capability is not yet enabled; discover only and do not execute.

entries.name: revit_create_duct
entries.title: create duct
entries.summary: Create a duct run between two points. All coordinates and dimensions are in Revit internal units (feet). Args: start_x: Start X coordinate in feet. start_y: Start Y coordinate in feet. start_z: Start Z coordinate in feet. end_x: End X coordinate in f
entries.when_to_use: Write capability is not yet enabled; discover only and do not execute.

entries.name: revit_create_pipe
entries.title: create pipe
entries.summary: Create a pipe run between two points. All coordinates and dimensions are in Revit internal units (feet). Args: start_x: Start X coordinate in feet. start_y: Start Y coordinate in feet. start_z: Start Z coordinate in feet. end_x: End X coordinate in f
entries.when_to_use: Write capability is not yet enabled; discover only and do not execute.

entries.name: revit_create_spot_elevation
entries.title: create spot elevation
entries.summary: Create a spot elevation annotation on an element. Spot elevations display the elevation at a specific point on an element. All coordinates are in Revit internal units (feet). Args: view_id: The view ID to place the spot elevation in. element_id: The
entries.when_to_use: Write capability is not yet enabled; discover only and do not execute.

entries.name: revit_create_tag
entries.title: create tag
entries.summary: Create a tag annotation for an MEP element. Tags display parameter values from the tagged element (e.g., duct size, pipe diameter, equipment name). All coordinates are in Revit internal units (feet). Args: view_id: The view ID to place the tag in. el
entries.when_to_use: Write capability is not yet enabled; discover only and do not execute.

entries.name: revit_create_text_note
entries.title: create text note
entries.summary: Create a text note annotation in a view. All coordinates are in Revit internal units (feet). Args: view_id: The view ID to place the text note in. text: The text content to display. x: X coordinate in feet. y: Y coordinate in feet. z: Z coordinate in
entries.when_to_use: Write capability is not yet enabled; discover only and do not execute.

entries.name: revit_delete_elements
entries.title: delete elements
entries.summary: Delete one or more elements from the model. Args: element_ids: List of element IDs to delete (as strings). document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. Returns a report with matched, deleted, and error counts plus details.
entries.when_to_use: Write capability is not yet enabled; discover only and do not execute.

entries.name: revit_get_active_document
entries.title: get active document
entries.summary: Get metadata about the active Revit document. Returns document title, path, worksharing status, and Revit version.
entries.when_to_use: Identify active document; not binding authorization.

entries.name: revit_get_categories
entries.title: get categories
entries.summary: List Revit category IDs/types and parameter binding support.
entries.when_to_use: Choose native category ID for typed queries.

entries.name: revit_get_connectors
entries.title: get connectors
entries.summary: Get MEP connectors of an element (equipment, fittings, etc.). Args: element_id: The Revit element ID (as string). document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. Returns a list of connectors with their ID, type, direction, co
entries.when_to_use: Connector topology read is NOT implemented by the current native Revit bridge (HTTP 501); do not invoke until reviewed host readback fixture exists.

entries.name: revit_get_element
entries.title: get element
entries.summary: Get a single element by its ID. Args: element_id: The Revit element ID (as string). document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. Returns the element with its properties and parameters.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect specific element properties by a confirmed element ID.

entries.name: revit_get_element_relationships
entries.title: get element relationships
entries.summary: Read Revit element element_relationships with type/host scoped metadata.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect geometry or host/level/type relationships before modifying Revit model.

entries.name: revit_get_geometry_summary
entries.title: get geometry summary
entries.summary: Read Revit element geometry_summary with type/host scoped metadata.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect geometry or host/level/type relationships before modifying Revit model.

entries.name: revit_get_parameters
entries.title: get parameters
entries.summary: Read all exact parameter names and typed metadata on a Revit element including type scope.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect parameters without relying on ambiguous display names.

entries.name: revit_get_runtime_info
entries.title: get runtime info
entries.summary: Return runtime, bridge, and open-document diagnostics without mutation.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect Revit MCP runtime health without touching project geometry.

entries.name: revit_get_selection
entries.title: get selection
entries.summary: get_selection in currently bound Revit UI; no document mutation.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect or control user-visible selection in current bound Revit model.

entries.name: revit_get_view_properties
entries.title: get view properties
entries.summary: Read scale, detail, discipline, template, crop and display style for a Revit view.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect exact native view formatting and template status.

entries.name: revit_group_elements
entries.title: group elements
entries.summary: Count placed elements grouped by category, family, type or level via native aggregate.
entries.when_to_use: Summarize placed elements by category, family, type or level.

entries.name: revit_list_annotations
entries.title: list annotations
entries.summary: List annotations in a specific view. Args: view_id: The view ID to list annotations from. annotation_type: Filter by type. Values: "text", "tag", "dimension", "spot_elevation", "detail_line". If not provided, returns all types. document_id: Optional
entries.when_to_use: List view annotations after selecting a view.

entries.name: revit_list_documents
entries.title: list documents
entries.summary: List all open Revit documents. Returns a list of document metadata including title and ID.
entries.when_to_use: List open project documents without changing binding.

entries.name: revit_list_elements
entries.title: list elements
entries.summary: List elements with optional filters. Args: document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. category: Filter by category name (e.g., "Walls", "Doors"). class_name: Filter by Revit API class (e.g., "Wall", "FamilyInstance"). fa
entries.when_to_use: Inventory actual placed instances; use category='Mechanical Equipment' to investigate FCU candidates, then inspect Family/Type and parameters before final classification.

entries.name: revit_list_families
entries.title: list families
entries.summary: List families loaded in the Revit project. Args: category: Filter by MEP category. Common values: "Mechanical Equipment", "Ducts", "Duct Fittings", "Pipes", "Pipe Fittings", "Plumbing Fixtures", "Lighting Fixtures", "Electrical Equipment", "Conduits"
entries.when_to_use: Discover loaded Family definitions; never use family count as installed equipment count.

entries.name: revit_list_family_types
entries.title: list family types
entries.summary: List family types (symbols) available in the project. Args: family: Filter by family name. category: Filter by MEP category name. document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. Returns a list of types with their ID, family n
entries.when_to_use: Discover loaded types; symbols may have zero placed instances.

entries.name: revit_list_levels
entries.title: list levels
entries.summary: List levels in the active or specified Revit document. Args: document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. Returns a list of levels with their ID, name, and elevation.
entries.when_to_use: List model Level elements and elevations, not stories inferred from view names.

entries.name: revit_list_mep_systems
entries.title: list MEP system instances
entries.summary: Read MechanicalSystem/PipingSystem instances and member counts, not system types.
entries.when_to_use: Identify actual systems in currently bound Revit model.

entries.name: revit_list_parameters
entries.title: list parameters
entries.summary: Read all exact parameter names and typed metadata on a Revit element including type scope.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect parameters without relying on ambiguous display names.

entries.name: revit_list_system_types
entries.title: list system types
entries.summary: List MEP system types in the project. Args: classification: Filter by system classification. Common values: "SupplyAir", "ReturnAir", "ExhaustAir", "HydronicSupply", "HydronicReturn", "DomesticColdWater", "DomesticHotWater", "Sanitary", "FireProtectW
entries.when_to_use: Enumerate MEP system type definitions, not system instances.

entries.name: revit_list_views
entries.title: list views
entries.summary: List views in the active or specified Revit document. Args: document_id: Optional document ID. Uses active document if not provided. Returns a list of views with their ID, name, view type, and discipline.
entries.when_to_use: Inventory views excluding templates.

entries.name: revit_move_element
entries.title: move element
entries.summary: Move an element by offset or to an absolute position. All coordinates are in Revit internal units (feet). Use dx/dy/dz for relative movement, or x/y/z for absolute position. If x/y/z are provided, dx/dy/dz are ignored. Args: element_id: The Revit ele
entries.when_to_use: Write capability is not yet enabled; discover only and do not execute.

entries.name: revit_place_family_instance
entries.title: place family instance
entries.summary: Place a family instance (MEP equipment, fixture, etc.) in the model. All coordinates are in Revit internal units (feet). Args: family: Family name (e.g., "AHU", "FCU", "Sink"). type: Type name within the family (e.g., "AHU-01", "36x24"). x: X coordin
entries.when_to_use: Write capability is not yet enabled; discover only and do not execute.

entries.name: revit_quantity_takeoff
entries.title: quantity takeoff
entries.summary: Read MEP quantities with explicit measured-length coverage.
entries.when_to_use: Quantify ducts/pipes/fittings/equipment/terminals without truncation.

entries.name: revit_query_spatial_and_warnings
entries.title: query spatial and warnings
entries.summary: Read bounded rooms, spaces, grids and Revit warning inventory.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect room/space/grids and native model warnings.

entries.name: revit_set_parameter
entries.title: set parameter
entries.summary: Set a parameter value on an element. Args: element_id: The Revit element ID (as string). parameter: Parameter name (e.g., "Width", "Height", "Diameter", "Comments"). value: New value. String for text, number for numeric, element ID string for element
entries.when_to_use: Write capability is not yet enabled; discover only and do not execute.

entries.name: revit_set_selection
entries.title: set selection
entries.summary: set_selection in currently bound Revit UI; no document mutation.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect or control user-visible selection in current bound Revit model.

entries.name: revit_show_elements
entries.title: show elements
entries.summary: show_elements in currently bound Revit UI; no document mutation.
entries.when_to_use: Inspect or control user-visible selection in current bound Revit model.

entries.name: revit_summarize_equipment
entries.title: summarize equipment
entries.summary: Summarize placed Mechanical Equipment by family/type.
entries.when_to_use: Count Mechanical Equipment instances by type and family.

entries.name: revit_temporary_visibility
entries.title: temporary visibility
entries.summary: Temporarily hide, isolate or reset elements in the bound Revit view; API requires Transaction.
entries.when_to_use: Modify temporary Revit view visibility without changing model binding.
